description: This PHP source file is a unit test class named EducationDaoTest that tests the functionalities of the EducationDao class related to CRUD operations for Education entities, including creation, update, retrieval by ID and name, listing, and deletion, within the OrangeHRM system's admin plugin.

classes.name: EducationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EducationDao in the OrangeHRM plugin, verifying methods like saveEducation, getEducationById, getEducationList, deleteEducations, isExistingEducationName, and getEducationByName.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EducationDao object and populates the database with test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testAddEducation
methods.description: Tests adding a new Education entity and verifies its persistence.

methods.name: testEditEducation
methods.description: Tests editing an existing Education entity and verifies the update.

methods.name: testGetEducationById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an Education entity by its ID.

methods.name: testGetEducationList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of Education entities with filtering parameters.

methods.name: testDeleteEducations
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple Education records by IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests deletion attempt on non-existent Education records.

methods.name: testIsExistingEducationName
methods.description: Tests checking the existence of an Education name in the database.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving an Education entity by its name, case-insensitive and with whitespace trimming.
